title: Authoring-evidence sidecar — prose evidence behind hand-authored containers (S4.6a, s4_plan 1.4.1)
description: Tier-1 shape validation only: field presence, types, and no extra keys (additionalProperties:false throughout). Everything the shape cannot say is the gate's (assert_evidence_gate): digest staleness, the one-entry-per-human-container correspondence, and orphan/misbound binding. node_digest is the 1.4.1b canonical node-structure digest (node_class + ordered children + owned atom ids), produced only by node_structure_digest — never hand-computed. authored_at_revision is informational bookkeeping (the map_revision current when the entry was written); it is NEVER a staleness trigger. The schema_version const is bound to the live AUTHORING_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION by evidence_schema_version_const() + the version-derived conforming fixture, never a free-floating literal.

schema_version.description: The sidecar document schema version. Bound to AUTHORING_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION via evidence_schema_version_const() — a bump here without the Python constant (or vice versa) fails the binding test.

entries.description: One entry per hand-authored container, keyed by node_id (duplicates are rejected at the typed build — a keyed table cannot hold two). May be empty: the sidecar is optional at generic load (1.4.1a); coverage is demanded by the S4.6 gate, not the shape.

node_id.description: The bound node's opaque id. Resolution against the live map is the gate's (orphan/misbound findings), not the shape's.

node_digest.description: The 1.4.1b canonical node-structure digest of the bound node at authoring time — the ONLY staleness key: evidence is stale iff the recomputed live digest differs.

evidence.description: The prose rationale for this container (scan-grounded authoring evidence). Whitespace-only prose is rejected at the typed build — minLength cannot see it.

authored_at_revision.description: The map_revision current when this entry was authored. Bookkeeping only (1.4.1b) — never consulted by the staleness check.
